notes: (1) The field_dev 0.2240 is a real result: independent rescoring matches the saved predictions and lab is ~0.99 through the same path. Errors are spread over many classes and are mostly confusion among shared classes (Strawberry leaf scorch, Tomato late blight, Corn healthy absorb many predictions); no proven cause is claimed. (2) EXIF: preprocess does not apply exif_transpose; 9 of 1040 field_dev photos carry a rotation tag (a tag value of 0 also appears), effect measured as negligible here (3 prediction flips, no change in correct count), but it is a real gap, already planned for T5.2, and is not named in the E2 notes or error analysis. (3) The E1 record does not store the restored checkpoint's sha256, so the checkpoint-to-E1 link is by best_dev_accuracy equality (enforced by the runner) plus my prediction-level match; it holds. The plan claim that the restore was bit-identical to the first run was not independently re-verified by me (first checkpoint was deleted). (4) Sheet category 'blur' is loosely defined (includes small low-res images), disclosed in the md; a few assignments are judgment calls, flagged as such in notes. (5) The mask check marks 16/40 good; my own view found #8 arguably fine, so it is slightly conservative, but the conclusion that field masks are unreliable (HSV threshold drops lesions, keeps soil/wood) is supported. (6) Real-photo Grad-CAM overlays exist only locally (git-ignored); I did not review them beyond mask-check images. (7) e2 records are two files (field_dev and lab_dev), as TESTING.md requires. GPU never used; nothing written to results/runs/ by me; my scripts are in orchestration/evidence/tmp-T3.2/.
